selected_script.angle: Trying to scrub grout lines by stepping on a wet floor rag with your foot just slips around and misses the recessed grime; use the V-shaped stand-up brush and professional formula to lock directly into the groove.
selected_script.hook: Shuffling a towel around with your foot won't reach what's stuck deep in your grout lines.

timeline: 0-3s: Close-up handheld phone shot of someone awkwardly stepping on a wet rag on a kitchen tile floor, trying to scrub a dirty grout line with their foot. The towel slips off, leaving the dark brown grout groove completely untouched and frustratingly dirty.

3-6s: Fast cut to the dual-action formula from the tall ribbed-neck white 32 oz Grout-eez bottle with red and blue label being poured onto the line, followed immediately by the wide bright blue V-shaped stand-up grout brush attached to a threaded pole locking directly into the groove while standing upright.

6-10s: Fast-cut scene 1 showing the first clear result in the kitchen; a single pass of the dense white twisted nylon bristles effortlessly lifts embedded grime, instantly revealing a clean, restored grout line.
video_001_part_01.voiceover: Shuffling a towel around with your foot won't reach what's stuck deep in your grout lines. Stop wasting your effort. Apply this professional-strength formula and let the V-shaped stand-up brush lock right into the grooves.
video_001_part_01.text_overlay: Towel scrubbing misses deep grout line dirt!

timeline: 0-4s: Fast-cut scene 2 in a laundry room ceramic tile environment; the bright blue V-shaped brush head swivels smoothly around tight corners and edges near the washing machine, loosening dirt without scratching the tile.
4-8s: Fast-cut scene 3 showing a wide view of a well-lit hallway floor with beautifully restored, bright grout lines, making the entire ceramic tile space look immaculately clean and refreshed.
8-10s: Short, light CTA overlay with a clean final shot of the clean tile floor and the brush resting neatly beside the bottle.
video_001_part_02.voiceover: It swivels easily around tight edges and restores dirty lines fast without kneeling. Make your space cleaner and cozier.
video_001_part_02.text_overlay: Make your space cleaner and cozier.
